Every startup we covered this week 👇

• a16z just took crypto out of its crypto fund’s name. Meet a16z Frontier
• This YC startup gets new hires to their first shift with AI agents, and just raised $15M
• This YC startup predicts factory breakdowns. Now worth $1.4B
• This a16z-backed SF startup helps investigators search evidence with AI, and just raised $20M
• This YC startup turns messy hospital records into AI training data. Just raised $9.5M
• This YC startup lets Indian traders bet on US stocks in rupees — and just raised $5.5M
• This YC startup gets AI chatbots to recommend your product — and just raised $1.3M
• The a16z-backed maker of AI coder Devin is reportedly weighing a $70B–$80B valuation
• Two ex-Palantir roommates built an AI that designs whole buildings — and a16z just put in $17M
• This 5-person YC startup fixes messy product listings for AI shopping bots — and just got acquired
• Salesforce is reportedly buying this a16z-backed military AI startup for $375M
• The founders of Stripe and Shopify backed this startup giving every AI agent its own computer. Now worth $1B
• This SF startup will pay you $20 an hour to walk its robot dogs
• This SF startup said no to Datadog — then raised $400M at a $3.8B valuation
• This Bay Area startup runs a robot-powered factory for drones and satellites — and just raised $100M
• One employee spent $30,000 in a week on AI
• Higgsfield's CEO: Google and OpenAI will kill $20 AI subscriptions
• This year-old AI lab has no product yet, and just raised $1 billion
• Higgsfield's CEO: I was wrong about AI replacing support teams
• Anthropic just filed to go public on Nasdaq as ANT
• Top creatives could soon spend $100,000 a month on AI
• This robot-brain startup has no revenue — and is reportedly in talks at a $20B valuation
• 90 minutes of film took 100+ hours of AI footage
• Their AI film prompts are 3,000 words long
• Sam Altman: in math, we have superintelligence now
